description: All user intents ChatWonder must recognize, with the data slots to collect per intent.

intents.name: collect_event_name
intents.description: Collect what occasion or event the user is dressing for

intents.name: collect_event_type
intents.description: Classify the event into a category used for outfit recommendations

slots.name: eventType
slots.prompt: Is this more of a casual or formal occasion?

intents.name: collect_datetime
intents.description: Collect when the event is happening. Normalize to ISO 8601 for the Calendar feature.

intents.name: collect_location
intents.description: Collect where the event is happening. Fed into the Maps feature for preview and directions.

intents.name: confirm_event
intents.description: User confirms all collected event details. Triggers calendar save and map preview.

intents.name: navigate
intents.description: Navigate to a different page by voice command

intents.name: get_directions
intents.description: Ask for directions to the event location

slots.name: destination
slots.prompt: Where do you need directions to?
